_comment: Brand impersonation and repackaging reference data.
_warning: NEVER invent or recall a certificate fingerprint, domain or package name from memory. An empty list means 'we cannot verify this brand yet' and is the CORRECT value. A fabricated fingerprint flags every legitimate app of that brand as malware, which is worse than having no check at all. Populate official_cert_sha256 only by running tools/collect_certs.py against an APK you obtained yourself from the vendor's official listing.

brands._note: Fictional brand used for the hackathon demo. Do not replace with a real bank without sourcing every field from official listings.

signer_history_note: Signer-change detection (core/signer_history.py) works with no brand data at all - it compares the cert seen for a package name against the cert stored from the previous scan. That path is the strongest repackaging signal and needs no entries here.
